paragraphs: It will cost more to use many big roads in Ireland from January. Transport Infrastructure Ireland, or TII, said this on Friday.
The M50 is a busy road around Dublin. Drivers with an account will pay 10 cent more for each trip. A trip will cost €2.70 or €3.30. Drivers with no account will pay €4.
Some drivers in the Dublin Port Tunnel will also pay more. A trip south between 6am and 10am will cost €15. That is €1 more than now.
Prices in shops went up by 3.6% in a year. That is why the tolls are going up. The money helps to look after the roads.
A group for lorry drivers is angry. Its leader, Ger Hyland, says the prices are too high. He wants special fast lanes for trucks.

paragraphs: Drivers will pay more on most of Ireland's toll roads from 1 January. Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII), which manages national roads, confirmed the news on Friday.

On the M50 around Dublin, drivers with a tag or video account will pay 10 cent more per trip. This means €2.70 with a tag and €3.30 with a video account. Drivers without an account will pay 20 cent more, or €4 a trip. The largest lorries will pay 20 or 30 cent more.

There are ten national toll roads. Most will go up by 10 cent, but the M3 toll between Clonee and Kells will stay the same. In the Dublin Port Tunnel, trips going south between 6am and 10am will rise by €1 to €15. TII says traffic at this time is growing, and it wants to keep space for lorries going to Dublin Port.
TII says the new prices follow inflation, which was 3.6% in the year to August. The money from tolls pays for running and repairing the roads.

Ger Hyland, president of the Irish Road Haulage Association, said the rises were unfair and asked TII to think again. He said lorry drivers already pay more than €8 at each toll and waste diesel when they stop. He wants special express lanes for trucks.
sentZh: 從1月1日起，駕駛在愛爾蘭大部分收費道路上將付更多錢。
管理國道的愛爾蘭交通基礎設施局（TII）週五證實了這個消息。
在環繞都柏林的M50上，有電子標籤或影像帳戶的駕駛每趟將多付10分錢。
也就是說，用電子標籤是2.70歐元，用影像帳戶是3.30歐元。
沒有帳戶的駕駛將多付20分錢，也就是每趟4歐元。
最大型的貨車將多付20或30分錢。
全國共有十條收費國道。
大多數將調漲10分錢，但克洛尼到凱爾斯之間的M3收費將維持不變。
在都柏林港隧道，早上六點到十點往南的行程將調漲1歐元，變成15歐元。
TII表示這個時段的車流正在增加，它希望為前往都柏林港的貨車保留空間。
TII表示新價格是依照通膨調整，截至八月的一年通膨率為3.6%。
收費的錢用來支付道路的營運和維修。
愛爾蘭道路貨運協會會長格爾．海蘭說調漲不公平，並要求TII重新考慮。
他說貨車司機每過一個收費站已經要付超過8歐元，停車時還會浪費柴油。
他希望設立卡車專用的快速車道。

paragraphs: Motorists face higher charges on most of the country's national toll roads from 1 January, Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII) has confirmed.

On the M50, the busiest route, tag and video account holders will pay an extra 10 cent per journey, bringing the fare to €2.70 and €3.30 respectively. Drivers without an account will pay 20 cent more, at €4 per trip, while the heaviest goods vehicles face increases of 20 or 30 cent.

Of the ten national toll roads, eight are run under public-private partnerships, and all but one of these will rise by 10 cent. The M3 toll between Clonee and Kells is unchanged. In the Dublin Port Tunnel, the southbound toll between 6am and 10am will climb by €1 to €15, which TII said reflects growing peak-time traffic and the need to protect capacity for heavy goods vehicles serving the port.
According to TII, tolls are adjusted each year in line with inflation, which stood at 3.6% in the 12 months to August. The revenue funds the operation and maintenance of the national road network.

However, Ger Hyland, president of the Irish Road Haulage Association, called the increases price gouging and urged TII to reconsider. He said hauliers already pay over €8 per crossing and burn up to two litres of diesel stopping and starting at toll booths, and he renewed calls for dedicated express lanes for trucks.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭交通基礎設施局（TII）證實，從1月1日起，駕駛人在全國大多數收費國道上將面臨更高的收費。
在最繁忙的M50路線上，電子標籤和影像帳戶持有人每趟將多付10分錢，費用分別變成2.70歐元和3.30歐元。
沒有帳戶的駕駛將多付20分錢，每趟4歐元，而最重型的貨車將面臨20或30分錢的漲幅。
在十條收費國道中，有八條以公私合作模式經營，其中除了一條以外都將調漲10分錢。
克洛尼到凱爾斯之間的M3收費維持不變。
在都柏林港隧道，早上六點到十點的南向收費將調漲1歐元至15歐元，TII表示這反映了尖峰時段車流增加，以及需要為服務港口的重型貨車保留容量。
根據TII的說法，收費每年依通膨調整，截至八月的12個月通膨率為3.6%。
這筆收入用於支應全國道路網的營運與維護。
然而，愛爾蘭道路貨運協會會長格爾．海蘭稱這次調漲是哄抬價格，並敦促TII重新考慮。
他說貨運業者每次通過已經要付超過8歐元，在收費亭停停走走還要燒掉多達兩公升柴油，他也再次呼籲設置卡車專用快速道。

paragraphs: Motorists are set to face steeper charges on the bulk of Ireland's national toll roads from 1 January, Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII) has confirmed.

On the M50, the country's most heavily used route, tag and video account holders will be charged an additional 10 cent per journey, lifting fares to €2.70 and €3.30 respectively. Unregistered drivers will shoulder a 20 cent rise to €4, while the heaviest goods vehicles will incur increments of 20 or 30 cent.

Eight of the ten national toll roads are operated through public-private partnerships, and all bar the M3 Clonee to Kells toll will rise by 10 cent. Meanwhile, the southbound Port Tunnel toll between 6am and 10am will jump by €1 to €15, a move TII attributes to mounting peak-hour congestion and the imperative of safeguarding capacity for hauliers bound for Dublin Port.
TII maintains that tolls are indexed to inflation, which ran at 3.6% in the year to August, and that the proceeds underwrite the upkeep of the national road network.

Hauliers, however, are incensed. Ger Hyland, president of the Irish Road Haulage Association, denounced the hikes as price gouging and implored TII to reconsider, pointing out that truckers already pay upwards of €8 per crossing and squander up to two litres of diesel idling at booths. He reiterated calls for dedicated express lanes.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭交通基礎設施局（TII）證實，從1月1日起，駕駛人在愛爾蘭大部分收費國道上將面臨更高昂的收費。
在全國使用量最大的M50上，電子標籤和影像帳戶持有人每趟將被加收10分錢，費用分別升至2.70歐元和3.30歐元。
未登記的駕駛將承擔20分錢的漲幅，變成4歐元，而最重型的貨車將被加收20或30分錢。
十條收費國道中有八條透過公私合作經營，除了M3克洛尼至凱爾斯段以外，都將調漲10分錢。
同時，早上六點到十點的港口隧道南向收費將跳漲1歐元至15歐元，TII將此歸因於尖峰時段日益壅塞，以及必須為前往都柏林港的貨運業者確保容量。
TII堅稱收費與通膨掛鉤，截至八月的一年通膨率為3.6%，而收入則用來支應全國道路網的維護。
然而，貨運業者怒不可遏。
愛爾蘭道路貨運協會會長格爾．海蘭痛斥這次漲價是哄抬價格，並懇求TII重新考慮，他指出卡車司機每次通過已付超過8歐元，還在收費亭怠速時白白浪費多達兩公升柴油。
他重申設置專用快速道的呼籲。

paragraphs: Motorists will be subject to increased charges on the majority of Ireland's national toll roads from 1 January, as confirmed by Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII).

On the M50, the nation's most extensively used route, tag and video account holders will incur an additional 10 cent per journey, resulting in fares of €2.70 and €3.30 respectively. Drivers without a registered account will face a 20 cent increase to €4, whereas the heaviest goods vehicles will be subject to rises of 20 or 30 cent.

Of the ten national toll roads, eight are operated under public-private partnerships, and all except the M3 Clonee to Kells toll will increase by 10 cent. TII asserts that toll levels are determined by an inflation-linked mechanism, with the relevant rate standing at 3.6% for the year to August. The resulting revenue is subsequently allocated to the operation and maintenance of the national road network.

Nevertheless, the haulage sector has responded with considerable hostility. Ger Hyland, president of the Irish Road Haulage Association, characterised the increases as price gouging and urged TII to reconsider, noting that hauliers already pay in excess of €8 per crossing and consume substantial quantities of diesel when idling at booths. 沒有登記帳戶的駕駛將面臨20分錢的漲幅，變成4歐元，而最重型的貨車將被調漲20或30分錢。
在十條收費國道中，八條以公私合作模式經營，除M3克洛尼至凱爾斯段外，都將調漲10分錢。
此外，早上六點到十點的港口隧道南向收費將調漲1歐元至15歐元，TII將此歸因於尖峰時段需求不斷攀升，以及必須為服務都柏林港的貨運車輛保留容量。
TII表示收費水準是由與通膨掛鉤的機制決定，截至八月一年的相關比率為3.6%。
由此產生的收入隨後會分配給全國道路網的營運與維護。
然而，貨運業界的反應相當敵對。
愛爾蘭道路貨運協會會長格爾．海蘭將調漲形容為哄抬價格，並敦促TII重新考慮，他指出貨運業者每次通過已付超過8歐元，在收費亭怠速時還消耗大量柴油。
